shared_elements: standing anthropomorphic figure carved in relief
incised linear motifs on a stone surface
justification: Both surfaces present schematic, frontal human-like forms carved in relief on stone, and A additionally carries incised curvilinear and circular motifs across its back that have no counterpart in B. B is a rock face bearing shallow, eroded standing figures set in vertical recessed panels with no accompanying symbols, whereas A is a single monolithic figure whose surface is covered with a distinctive composition of concentric circles, arcs and a broad banded girdle — a specific iconographic scheme entirely absent from B.
